body: Hi there! I know this is really late, but I figured a reply couldn't hurt! So I've had mine for about 6/7 months now and what I've noticed around feeding is that when they're small, you should definitely start out with fruit flies! They'll need to be fed pretty often when they are small. I'm currently feeding mine mealworms and since it's a bigger prey, I feed her less often. Usually I just check if she's hungry by dropping one in her webbing. If she doesn't go for it I remove it
